messages:
anya: onboarding stella-60k int4-v3 to dedi-longctx-4. found a reproducible dropout around 58k tokens where model skips a 3-token span. kv-cache shows a gap at the same pos range. anyone seen dropout tied to shard rebalancing?

mike: can you paste repro + whether this was during a live shard-join? any prefetching or background compaction running?

anya: repro command:```
./longrun --model stella-60k-int4v3 --prefill 58500 --seed 7 --dump-kv kv_trace.json --log-level info
```
log snip:```
[INFO] prefill: 58512 tokens
[DEBUG] shard_manager: initiating shard_join shard=2 -> shard=3 (reason=scale_up)
[DEBUG] kv_commit: pos_span=58096..58111 shard=2
[WARN] kv_hole detected: missing_span=58112..58114 expected_owner=2 found_owner=3
[ERROR] gen_drop: tokens_dropped=3 window_start=58112
```

ellie: shard join in the middle of prefill would explain owner mismatch, but we should be able to remap. is the shard-join code holding locks for in-flight kv inserts?

mike: current shard-join flow does a lazy migrate: it updates owner map then migrates ranges asynchronously. if a prefill insert races it may write to old shard but the owner map flips and a subsequent read sees "not found" until migration finishes -> temporary hole. not RoPE-specific but causes semantic dropout.

anya: interesting: two runs with shard-join disabled (env SHARD_JOIN=0) show no dropout. enabling join reproduces dropout reliably. also noticed rotary_scale logged as 0.9999998807907104 around the window but that might be red herring.

ellie: mitigation options: 1) make shard-join synchronous for prefill windows (block join until prefill finishes), 2) make kv reads tolerant to transient owner mismatch by checking old shard replicas, 3) add prefill epoch tag so gets consult both maps during join. tradeoffs?

mike: 1) simplest to ship as hotfix (block joins for running long-prefill jobs). 2) more robust but more infra work and perf subtlety. 3) hybrid: epoch tags cheap and safe.

anya: I'll open ML ticket ML-1600 with repro and logs. for immediate safety I suggest ops block shard-joins on dedi-longctx pools for next 48h and we run canaries.

bench-bot: scheduled canaries: stella60k-shardjoin-block -> pool:dedi-longctx-4 (24h), stella60k-shardjoin-allowed -> pool:dedi-longctx-4 (24h). will diff token streams and kv traces at /bench/stella60k/shardjoin_ab. ETA 18h. :robot_face:

ops-bot: blocked auto-scale/shard-join for pool:dedi-longctx-4 until ML-1600 resolved. alerting infra-team.

ellie: I'll prototype epoch-tagging for prefill writes: attach epoch id to kv spans and let reads consult both current and previous owner for matching epoch until migration confirms. will add unit test for mid-join prefill.

mike: add a longctx-eval that runs stochastic shard-join during long-prefill with a goldset and asserts no token drop. we should also log owner_map transitions in more detail for triage.

anya: TL;DR: stella-60k int4 long-prefill observed 3-token dropout when shard-join raced prefill writes; disabling shard-join removes the dropout; ticket ML-1600 created; canaries + short-term ops block in place; infra fix (epoch tags) in progress.
